name: sizeof-pointer
title: sizeof(pointer) is not buffer length
fix_goal: Do not use sizeof on a pointer when the intended value is the allocation length.
fix_steps: Find the p101_write call using sizeof(buffer).
Notice that buffer is a pointer, so sizeof(buffer) is the pointer size.
Use args->bytes or another explicit length value instead.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the output-size lab is fixed.
lesson: Arrays remember their size only in the declaring scope; once you have a pointer, sizeof tells you pointer width.
